actions.name: [Arena] Select clip (focus, no trigger)
actions.description: Selects (focuses) a clip in the Arena UI without triggering it.

actions.name: [Arena] Select column (focus, no trigger)
actions.description: Selects (focuses) a column in the Arena UI without triggering it.

actions.name: [Arena] Clear layer
actions.description: Clears the specified layer. Sends 1 then 0 after 100ms (momentary).

actions.name: [Arena] Layer opacity
actions.description: Sets the video opacity of a layer (0.0 = transparent, 1.0 = full).

actions.name: [Arena] Layer bypass
actions.description: Sets the bypass (mute) state of a layer.

actions.name: [Arena] Master composition opacity
actions.description: Sets the master video opacity of the composition (0.0 – 1.0).

actions.name: [Arena] Set BPM
actions.description: Sets the composition BPM/tempo. Normalized to the configured BPM range (Connection settings) unless "actual BPM value" mode is enabled.

actions.name: [Arena] Tap tempo
actions.description: Sends a tap tempo trigger to Arena.

actions.name: [Arena] Trigger group column
actions.description: Triggers (connects) a column within a group.

actions.name: [Arena] Select group column (focus, no trigger)
actions.description: Selects (focuses) a column within a group without triggering it.

actions.name: [Arena] Set audio volume
actions.description: Sets audio volume to an absolute value. Smooth fade ramps over 400ms (16 steps).

actions.name: [Arena] Set composition speed
actions.description: Sets composition speed immediately to an absolute value (0.0–1.0).

actions.name: [Arena] Audio volume — velocity nudge
actions.description: Each press adjusts volume. Press faster for larger steps (velocity-sensitive). Supports rotary redirection from the Quick Control Panel.

options.label: Menu active guard — suppress this action while the Control Panel is open; redirect to its Volume/Master tool instead if one is armed

actions.name: [Arena] Composition speed — velocity nudge
actions.description: Each press adjusts composition speed (0.0–1.0 float). Press faster for larger steps. Supports rotary redirection from the Quick Control Panel.

options.label: Menu active guard — suppress this action while the Control Panel is open; redirect to its Volume/Master tool instead if one is armed

actions.name: [Arena] Master opacity — velocity nudge
actions.description: Each press adjusts master composition opacity. Press faster for larger steps. Supports rotary redirection from the Quick Control Panel.

options.label: Menu active guard — suppress this action while the Control Panel is open; redirect to its Volume/Master tool instead if one is armed

actions.name: OSC: Float nudge (any path)
actions.description: Velocity-sensitive nudge for any OSC float parameter. Assign the "Up" variant to rotate_right and "Down" to rotate_left to turn any encoder into a controller for any Arena parameter (color, intensity, effect level…). The current value is tracked internally and queried from Arena on the first press.

options.label: Query current value from Arena when unknown

actions.name: [Arena] Preset slot — Trigger / Assign
actions.description: Edit/delete mode ON → assign or delete. Slot empty → 3s quick-assign. Slot filled → trigger.

actions.name: [Arena] Preset slot — Toggle edit mode
actions.description: While edit mode is active, pressing a slot assigns the current Arena selection.

actions.name: [Arena] Preset slot — Toggle delete mode
actions.description: While delete mode is active, pressing a slot clears it (red blink).

options.label: Clear this slot now
options.description: Button field (type "simple") with the button text "Clear Slot"; carries no value used by the callback.

actions.name: [Arena] Set clip autopilot from duration minus layer transition
actions.description: Press 1: previews computed autopilot time on button. Press 2 (within 8s): sends to Arena. Computes clip_duration − transition − offset.

options.label: Use specific layer / clip instead of last selected

actions.name: [Arena] Set layer transition duration
actions.description: Sets the transition duration (in seconds) for a layer.

actions.name: [Arena] Install Resolume Arena shortcuts file
actions.description: Writes the ARENA-OSC.xml OSC shortcut preset to the Resolume Arena Presets/Shortcuts folder on this machine. OSC shortcuts define which paths Arena sends as output feedback.

options.label: Target folder (leave blank for default: %APPDATA%\Resolume Arena)

actions.name: [Arena] Loop-start — hold autopilot loop
actions.description: While active: 1 second before each clip cycle end, increments autopilot/loops by 1, deferring autopilot indefinitely. Press Loop-fin to stop.

actions.name: [Arena] Loop-fin — release autopilot loop
actions.description: Stops the Loop-start watcher. Autopilot will fire normally on the next cycle end.

actions.name: [Arena] Toggle real-time progress polling
actions.description: Enables/disables periodic clip position re-sync at runtime (mirrors the Connection setting). Useful to quickly reduce OSC traffic on sensitive networks.

actions.name: [Arena] Check connection (ping)
actions.description: Measures OSC round-trip latency and jitter to Arena using a lightweight query. Updates arena_ping_ms / arena_ping_jitter_ms.

actions.name: [Arena] Control Panel — Activate
actions.description: Toggles the Quick Control Panel. While inactive, Control Panel slot buttons stay in "bypass". While active, 3 tabs of tools: Tab 1 — Paint / ACT MGR / Edit Mode / Del Mode; Tab 2 — Master / Vol / Speed rotary menus; Tab 3 — Ping / Poll Toggle / OSC Reconnect / Del All. Rotate encoder to switch tabs.

actions.name: [Arena] Control Panel — Slot press
actions.description: Bound to one of the Control Panel slot buttons (1..N). Does nothing while the panel is inactive ("bypass"). Slot count is set in Connection settings.

actions.name: [Arena] Control Panel — Slot rotate
actions.description: Add to rotate_left / rotate_right steps of a physical encoder. Behaviour: during Paint picker — scrolls color wheel; when Vol/Master/Speed is armed — controls that parameter; otherwise — scrolls between the 3 tool tabs. Bypass while panel is inactive.

feedbacks.name: [Arena] Preset slot display
feedbacks.description: Shows clip/column name and color. Blinks orange (edit), red (delete), amber (quick-assign). Shows live progress bar when the assigned clip is playing.

options.label: Show progress bar when clip is playing

feedbacks.name: [Arena] Edit mode active
feedbacks.description: True while edit mode is ON.

feedbacks.name: [Arena] Delete mode active
feedbacks.description: True while delete mode is ON.

feedbacks.name: [Arena] Last selection type
feedbacks.description: True when last Arena selection matches the configured type.

feedbacks.name: [Arena] BPM value
feedbacks.description: True when Arena BPM matches the comparison.

feedbacks.name: [Arena] Progress polling status
feedbacks.description: True while real-time clip progress polling is active.

feedbacks.name: [Arena] User variable state
feedbacks.description: True when the selected user variable is ON. Bind to any button to use as a custom indicator.

feedbacks.name: [Arena] Connection check (ping) status
feedbacks.description: Colors by last measured OSC round-trip time. Run "[Arena] Check connection (ping)" to update.

feedbacks.name: [Arena] Control Panel — Slot display
feedbacks.description: While the Quick Control Panel is inactive, this returns no override (stays in "bypass" — free to show anything else). While active, shows the current tool page, or — during Paint — a color-wheel swatch.

feedbacks.name: [Arena] Layer bypass state
feedbacks.description: True when the layer is bypassed (muted).

feedbacks.name: [Arena] Layer opacity value
feedbacks.description: True when layer opacity matches comparison.

feedbacks.name: Listen for OSC messages (Integer)
feedbacks.description: Requires "Listen for Feedback" to be enabled.

feedbacks.name: Listen for OSC messages (Float)
feedbacks.description: Requires "Listen for Feedback" to be enabled.

feedbacks.name: Listen for OSC messages (Boolean)
feedbacks.description: Requires "Listen for Feedback" to be enabled.

feedbacks.name: Listen for OSC messages (String)
feedbacks.description: Requires "Listen for Feedback" to be enabled.

feedbacks.name: Listen for OSC messages (Multiple Arguments)
feedbacks.description: Requires "Listen for Feedback" to be enabled.

feedbacks.name: Listen for OSC messages (No Arguments)
feedbacks.description: Requires "Listen for Feedback" to be enabled.

feedbacks.name: OSC: Progress Bar (Layer)
feedbacks.description: Visual progress bar for layer clip playback. Green → Orange → Red → Fast blink (≤5s). Always full green if looping. Requires "Listen for Feedback".

feedbacks.name: OSC: Active Column
feedbacks.description: True when the specified column is the currently active composition column. Requires "Listen for Feedback".

feedbacks.name: OSC: Clip connected (playing)
feedbacks.description: True when the specified layer + clip slot is the currently connected (playing) clip. Requires "Listen for Feedback".

feedbacks.name: OSC: Clip looping
feedbacks.description: True when the active clip on the layer is in a looping playmode (Loop, Ping Pong, Random). Requires "Listen for Feedback".

feedbacks.name: OSC: Group Column active (connected)
feedbacks.description: True when the specified column is currently the active (connected) column in the group. Requires "Listen for Feedback".

feedbacks.name: [Arena] Autopilot — preview / result
feedbacks.description: Shows preview (press 1) or confirmed result (press 2) of arena_autopilot_set.

notes: Complete list: 39 actions (src/index.js updateActions, one setActionDefinitions call with 39 plain properties) and 23 feedbacks (updateFeedbacks, one setFeedbackDefinitions call): 18 boolean and 5 advanced (preset_slot, arena_ping_status, arena_control_slot, oscProgressBar, arena_autopilot_info). Both calls are unconditional; no definition is generated per layer, clip or model, and all choices are literal lists. The entries were extracted with the TypeScript compiler API from the literals of src/index.js and checked against the source by hand on a sample (send_blob, send_multiple, arena_layer_opacity, arena_bpm_value, user_var, arena_layer_bypass, osc_feedback_noargs, oscProgressBar, preset_slot_clear).

Third-party community module (repository ElytaM/companion-module-resolume-arena-osc-unofficial, outside the bitfocus organization); not verified whether it is listed in the Companion module store. Unofficial: it controls Resolume Arena only over OSC (not the REST/WebSocket API, except optional REST thumbnail requests to the Arena web server, src/thumbnail-client.js, default port 8080).

Protocol and config (src/index.js getConfigFields, src/utils.js setupOSC): OSC over UDP (default), TCP or raw TCP to the Arena host (targetPort default "7000"); optional feedback listening (feedbackPort default "7001", UDP only); optional second machine (Arena 2, UDP, ports 7000/7002/8080 by default), up to five OSC relays that forward incoming UDP messages, remote control via an OSC path prefix (default /companion), BPM range (default 20-500 or "actual BPM" mode) and a Quick Control Panel slot count (default 4, 2-8). Variables and presets are not catalogued (src/index.js setVariableDefinitions, setPresetDefinitions).

Layer, clip, column and group numbers of the [Arena] actions are text inputs with Regex.NUMBER (/^\d+$/) and useVariables, so values are strings; the callbacks parseInt them. Float fields use Regex.SIGNED_FLOAT, integer fields Regex.SIGNED_NUMBER (resolved from @companion-module/base 2.1.2, dist/module-api/enums.js). Several [Arena] fields are number fields (autopilot, loop, nudge and Control Panel actions).

Colorpicker defaults are computed in the source with this._rgb(r, g, b) = (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b and are recorded as the resulting integers (for example 20680 = rgb(0, 80, 200)); the colour fields of oscProgressBar also set returnType: "number".

Generic send_* actions and all [Arena] actions use _sendOSC(path, args) with the default machine 1; only preset slots carry a machine number (src/index.js _triggerSlot), so Arena 2 is reached through slots, not through these actions.

The dropdown choice ids of the comparison options are lowercase words (equal, greaterthan, lessthan, greaterthanequal, lessthanequal, notequal); the three non-numeric OSC feedbacks offer only equal and notequal.

Several actions are stateful, not plain OSC sends: arena_autopilot_set needs two presses (preview, then send within 8 s), arena_audio_volume_nudge/arena_speed_nudge/arena_master_opacity_nudge/arena_float_nudge scale the step with press speed (min_step/max_step), arena_loop_start/arena_loop_fin start and stop a watcher, and the preset_slot_* and arena_control_* actions edit the module state (slots are stored by the module, src/index.js _savePresetSlots).
arena_install_resolume_shortcuts writes a file (default ARENA-OSC.xml, default folder %APPDATA%\Resolume Arena when the folder option is blank) on the machine that runs Companion.
The static-text fields inside action and feedback options (id "w") and the "simple" button field of preset_slot_clear are recorded with type other and a rawType; they hold no value.
No test against a running Arena or Companion; the module runs on node22 with @companion-module/base ^2.1.2, so option values may be expressions.
